name: test-layout-relocation
body: Each source module carries `#[cfg(test)] mod tests;` pointing at `src/<module>/tests.rs`, preserving the module path (e.g. `rust.apg.plan_cmd.tests.unit`) so the tier filters and graph queries resolve. Each source module's e2e tests live in a top-level integration crate (`tests/main_e2e.rs`, `tests/plan_cmd_e2e.rs`, `tests/git_e2e.rs`, …) sharing `tests/common/mod.rs`, and each e2e test carries `#[ignore = "e2e tier: …; run via cargo test-e2e"]`. The e2e tests call crate-internal functions, so `testutil` is part of the library surface for the integration crates to compile.
